articles_published_chk.name: articles_published_chk
articles_published_chk.value: "articles"."status" <> 'published' or ("articles"."editor_id" is not null and "articles"."published_at" is not null)

listings_live_dates_chk.name: listings_live_dates_chk
listings_live_dates_chk.value: "listings"."status" <> 'live' or ("listings"."published_at" is not null and "listings"."expires_at" is not null)

mandates_comp_range_chk.name: mandates_comp_range_chk
mandates_comp_range_chk.value: "mandates"."comp_min" is null or "mandates"."comp_max" is null or ("mandates"."comp_min" > 0 and "mandates"."comp_min" <= "mandates"."comp_max")

matches_reviewed_chk.name: matches_reviewed_chk
matches_reviewed_chk.value: "matches"."status" in ('proposed') or ("matches"."reviewed_by" is not null and "matches"."reviewed_at" is not null)
